ruleDefinitions.name: Potential CCleanerReactivator.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "CCleanerReactivator.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\CCleanerReactivator\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\CCleaner\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\CCleaner\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\CCleanerReactivator\\\.exe$")))
